channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: mixed (+0.7).

item.title: [+1] US trade deal on a steady keel: Piyush Goyal on Sitharaman’s ‘plateaued’ remark | ETSA 2026
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 8 reports from DD News, Traders Union, The Economic Times and 5 more. Related: “Bangladesh calls for India to lift ‘anti-dumping’ duties in trade talks”. Turn: earlier readings (5 Oct) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] New York Federal Reserve says inflation on everyday items is because of tariffs
item.description:
Signal: global trade barriers (global). 3 reports from The Economic Times, GujaratSamachar English, WSMH. Related: “‘We are a self-respecting country’: Piyush Goyal on Russian oil and US tariff threat | ETSA 2026”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 4 Oct).

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Slower world trade

Why it matters: Tariff escalation between major economies slows world trade and demand for Indian exports, though some supply chains may shift towards India.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Additive Manufacturing gains momentum in India as government prepares NSAM 2.0
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 2 reports from DD News, DD India. Related: “India’s industrial output grows 7.3% in June; manufacturing expands 7.8%”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
